name: Real World — The Mission brand tokens
canonical_source: marketing/BRAND.md — when this file and BRAND.md disagree, BRAND.md wins; fix this file in the same commit

accent.name: Café-light amber
accent.contrast_on_bg: 7.4:1 AA large — never body text under 18px

accent-3.name: Mural red
accent-3.role: sparingly: alerts, one window in the mark

typography.raster_fallback: DejaVu Sans (Bold for display, Regular for captions)

logo.mark: dark Mission rowhouse tile, corniced facade, 3x3 window grid, one lit amber window (center), one green, one red

lit_window.rule: always amber — never a theming slot

logo.clear_space: >= half the icon tile height on all sides

files.logo-primary.svg: horizontal lockup, light text — dark backgrounds
files.logo-primary-dark.svg: horizontal lockup, dark ink — light backgrounds ONLY
files.logo-icon.svg: icon tile — avatar, favicon, square contexts
files.logo-icon-animated.svg: lit-window breathing variant — web contexts where motion is appropriate; honors prefers-reduced-motion

banner_files.banner-youtube-2560x1440.png: YouTube channel art — safe zone = center 1546x423

voice.one_line: a neighbor who knows the block — warm, plain-spoken, slightly wry
never: promises of possessing the main cast

taglines.primary: A neighborhood that's alive whether you're watching or not.
taglines.primary_alt: A neighborhood that never stops performing.
taglines.short: Watch free. Pay to reach in.
taglines.descriptive: The Truman Show you can visit.
